question: The average price of three items of furniture is ₹5,305. If their prices are in the ratio 3 : 5 : 7, the price of the cheapest item (in ₹) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the ratio parts 3, 5, and 7 form an arithmetic progression, their average is exactly the middle term.

⇒ Average = 5 units

⇒ 5 units = ₹5,305

⇒ 1 unit = 5,305 ÷ 5 = ₹1,061

⇒ Price of the cheapest item (3 units) = 3 × 1,061 = ₹3,183

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3,183.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
